**Finding: LD — compliant (preferred position met).**

No Customer-payable liquidated damages or penalties exist anywhere in the agreement:

- **§ 14 Termination (p0079):** Client may terminate on written notice; services continue to the last day of the following month. No early-termination fee, no make-whole, no stipulated sum.
- **§ 7 / § 8(f) (p0049, p0058):** the anti-spamming covenants carry no per-message or fixed monetary penalty — TrueLink retains only its ordinary legal and equitable remedies.
- **§ 5(a) (p0045):** the minimum monthly amounts are fees for services provided during the term, not a liquidated amount triggered by breach or termination.
- **§ 12 liability cap (p0077):** runs in our favour (caps TrueLink), so not flagged.

Noted in the rationale only (not a deviation): the monthly minimums and the Support Services period remain blank and should be completed commercially. No redline proposed.
